title: A table-driven test
prompt: Arrange the lines into one parametrized pytest test that checks `pue` against a small table of hand-worked cases. One block compares floats the fragile way and doesn't belong.
hints: Imports, then the decorator directly above the test function it parametrizes, then the body.
pytest runs the test once per tuple in the table, passing the values as arguments. Look at the second case: 0.3 / 0.1 in floating point is 2.9999999999999996.
The body compares with `pytest.approx(expected)`, not `== expected`.
